note: apps/api `tsc --noEmit` errors that predate the Knowledge Plane Context Plane adoption. Verified byte-identical at 59fe281d8 (the commit before the Phase 20-26 overlay d8a97dfec) and at 9c302d260. Every entry is in a *.spec.ts file, so none of them reaches a shipped bundle. Keys are `<path>|TS<code>` with no line/column, so unrelated edits that shift lines do not create false failures. Values are the exact occurrence count. validate-knowledge-plane-phase26.mjs fails on any NEW key or any increased count; a decreased count is reported as progress and must be trimmed here.
